verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a hosted SaaS, and the evidence shows no open-source license for its core platform. The only openness evidence is community reports that its first-party Relay Proxy, a Go application you run on your own infrastructure, is open source. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core flag service, a named license, first-party documentation of a public source repository, and open-source status of the SDKs, CLI or MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: LaunchDarkly has an open source 'Relay' you can run in your own environment for extra resiliency.
LD's open-source Relay lets you run proxies closer to your services.
a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure.
